about.title: About Us
about.p1: We are expatriates from Mokbulpur village. We save together — building a fund for our community's welfare and to stand beside neighbours when they need us.
about.p2: All contributions and expenses flow through a single transparent ledger. Every taka collected and every taka spent is openly recorded on this site. Built on trust.

whatWeDo.title: Why Saving Together Matters
whatWeDo.subtitle: Pooled monthly contributions build resilience, community trust, and a fund ready for whatever comes.
whatWeDo.securityBody: A safety net for emergencies — illness, calamity, or family hardship. No member stands alone when life turns hard.
whatWeDo.collectiveBody: Twenty hands together can build what one alone cannot — a fund that reflects our shared commitment to home.
whatWeDo.growthBody: Small monthly contributions compound into something significant — ready for the next ten years, twenty years, and beyond.
whatWeDo.transparencyBody: Every contribution and every disbursement is recorded — visible to all members, all the time.

rules.title: Rules & Policies
rules.subtitle: All terms and conditions of the Makbulpur Probasi savings society.
section1List: Any expatriate from Makbulpur village may become a member.
Once recorded, a member's history is preserved — accounts cannot be deleted.
Inactive members remain visible in the records for transparency.
section2List: The joining month requires a payment of 5,000 BDT (joining fee + first month).
All members pay the same amount — no exceptions or favoritism.
section3List: Members must pay between the 1st and 10th of every month.
After the 10th, the entry is automatically marked as late.
Two collectors — Rahat & Jubayer — receive contributions.
section4List: Late payments are publicly displayed on the savings sheet with a red marker.
The fine amount per missed month will be set separately by the committee.
Payment in arrears is always welcome and recorded with the original month.
section5List: Funds are spent only on community needs — mosque, graveyard, helping the needy, infrastructure.
Major expenses require collective agreement before disbursement.
Every expense is recorded with receipts (where applicable) and visible to all.
section6List: Every payment, every expense, every member — all visible without login.
Only the admin can edit records; the public can verify everything in real time.
Disputes are resolved by the committee with reference to this public ledger.
rules.closingNote: These rules may be revised by the committee. Any changes will be announced here and shared with all members.
